title: CI: tests and clippy under each feature set, and the wasm32 build without std
body: The guidance now wants CI to build --no-default-features for wasm32, and rust.clippy-clean wants clippy in CI under every feature set; sylva's only workflow is cargo-deny. A workflow: cargo test and clippy -D warnings with all features, default and no default features, plus cargo build --no-default-features --target wasm32-unknown-unknown, taking the toolchain from rust-toolchain.toml.

title: Error's feature-gated variants: make Error #[non_exhaustive], with tend and alfred
body: rust.features-additive: Error gains Io with std, Json with log or knowledge, Db with sqlite, so an exhaustive match in one crate breaks when another enables the feature. tend (tend-core/src/error.rs:46) and alfred (alfred-core/src/error.rs:32) match it exhaustively, so each needs a wildcard arm first (grafts to them), then #[non_exhaustive] here. Nothing breaks today: both build with every feature on.
